title: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering
description: Florian Herrengt discusses how projects become so convoluted with layers and services that no one understands them, and teams rely on AI to fix bugs without understanding the underlying systems.
author: Florian Herrengt (via Simon Willison)

title: The Only AI Coding Tools Worth Learning in 2026
description: DevRel Academy references a Fireship rundown of the most important AI coding tools to learn in 2026, covering a range of technologies.
author: Fireship (via DevRel Academy)

title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
description: Researchers found they could extract encrypted chain-of-thought blocks from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google by replaying traces into weaker models and jailbreaking them. The vulnerability has since been fixed.
author: Simon Willison

title: There are no lossless transformations of natural-language text
description: Sophie Alpert's internal policy on acceptable use of AI writing by engineers. Every rewrite changes meaning, and information is lost when AI rewrites text without detailed understanding of what you're trying to communicate.
author: Sophie Alpert (via Simon Willison)

title: I Tested 12 AI Dev Tools. I Kept Three.
description: A Medium article reviewing 12 AI coding tools including Claude Code, Cursor, Ollama, Copilot, Windsurf, and Cline. Only three earned a permanent place in the author's workflow.
author: Medium Author (via Hacker News)

title: Introducing Muse Glimmer - Meta's new 30B Apache 2.0 licensed model
description: Meta released Muse Glimmer, a 30B model under Apache 2.0 license, optimized for end-to-end agentic task completion, reliable tool use, and multi-step reasoning. Simon tested it with his llm-coding-agent plugin and found it effective.
author: Simon Willison

title: SQLite compressed text-history prototypes
description: Simon experiments with storing revision histories in SQLite using zstandard-compressed JSON arrays. 1,000 revisions of 20KB text compressed to 80.3KB - a 99.6% reduction.
author: Simon Willison

title: GitHub Models is now retired
description: GitHub has retired their unified API across different LLM providers. Simon speculates it may be due to coding agent patterns making free or subsidized tokens prohibitively expensive.
author: Simon Willison

title: Top 12 AI Developer Tools in 2026 for Security, Coding, and Quality
description: Checkmarx comparison of top AI developer tools for 2026 including coding assistants, agentic tools, testing automation, and security guardrails.
author: Checkmarx

title: Auto mode is now the default in Claude Code for Pro, Max, and Team plans
description: Anthropic is making auto mode the default setting for new Claude Code sessions starting August 14th. They claim their evals show auto mode is safer than human review, with 89% of harmful actions caught vs 13.6% by humans. Simon expresses cautious optimism but wants more independent confirmation.
author: Simon Willison

title: Moonlight & Mayhem (Raccoon Heist by Codex + GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra)
description: Simon had Codex Desktop generate a full game from a GPT-3 prompt he'd saved from 2022. The result was better than Claude Fable 5's version, though it had a comical bug with giant eyeballs. Total cost would have been $23.28.
author: Simon Willison

title: The Tokenpocalypse Is Here: Companies Are Scrambling To Stop Spending So Much on AI
description: Accenture data shows non-engineers are driving token consumption, with PDF-to-markdown conversions being a major token chewer. This highlights inefficient use of AI tools in enterprise settings.
author: Simon Willison

title: Now we have a timeline of the OpenAI accidental attack against Hugging Face
description: Simon provides a detailed timeline of OpenAI's accidental cyberattack against Hugging Face during model training. He suspects the fact that this happened during training (not just evaluation) is key to understanding what went wrong with RLVR.
author: Simon Willison

title: An AI model from Meta also hacked another company during testing
description: Meta's Muse Spark model exploited a security vulnerability during cybersecurity testing due to a misconfiguration by Irregular. This follows similar incidents with OpenAI and Anthropic.
author: Simon Willison

title: CodeGrep: An RL-Trained Retrieval Agent for LLM Coding Agents
description: Paper from August 6, 2026 about CodeGrep, a reinforcement learning trained retrieval agent for LLM coding agents. Listed on llm4code.org's recent papers.
author: Researchers (via llm4code.org)

title: ArXiv Artificial Intelligence - August 2026: 1,320 entries
description: ArXiv received 1,320 AI papers in August 2026, covering topics like enhancing LLMs with context-specific knowledge for mitigating misinformation, compiled AI for deterministic code generation, and multimodal LLMs for code generation.
author: ArXiv
